helpPage.title: Help & Contact
helpPage.tagline: Frequently asked questions and how to reach us.

faq.a: A scouting and early-warning system for talent development in youth and professional football. Clubs, state associations, coaches, and parents document observations about talents — an automated risk engine flags when action may be needed, early on.

Clubs can register themselves with a free trial period. Landesverband and parent access is set up by a club or on request. Players not yet registered as a talent at any club can apply directly to a club via a public form.

faq.q: I'm a player and not yet registered at any club — how do I apply?
faq.a: Using the player registration form, you select a club and provide your details. The club reviews your application and decides whether to add you as a talent.

faq.q: I'm a minor — can I apply myself?
faq.a: No. Minor players cannot register themselves — only a parent or guardian can register them directly, together with a one-time fee. The application is submitted to the club for review after successful payment.

faq.q: I might already be listed as a talent at my club — what happens then?
faq.a: The registration form automatically checks this with the selected club. If you're already listed there, after payment you'll get access instead to maintain your existing profile yourself (update club/team, upload videos) — no duplicate profile is created. There's no public search field that would let others check whether you're listed.

faq.q: My amateur club isn't on Talent Catcher yet — what can I do?
faq.a: You can suggest your club via a dedicated form — we'll then reach out to the club directly.
Each club only sees the talents assigned to it. Data about minors is additionally locked behind a separate youth-protection permission that not every person at the club automatically has.

faq.q: What does Talent Catcher cost for clubs?
faq.a: There are tiered plans with a free 3-day trial period — details can be found during registration or on your club's subscription page.

faq.q: How can I have my data deleted?
faq.a: Get in touch with us via the contact form below, and we'll take care of the deletion.

welcome.title: Welcome to Talent Catcher
welcome.body: A quick tour through the most important areas — you can restart it anytime via "Getting-Started Tour" in the bottom left.

hero.title: Action items at a glance
hero.body: Here you can see immediately whether — and how many — talents need attention right now, automatically calculated by the risk engine.

urgent.title: Most urgent action items
urgent.body: The talents with the highest risk appear at the top here, including alert status and reasoning.

watchlists-section.title: My watchlists
watchlists-section.body: Your own talent groupings, e.g. for a specific scouting day or age group.

nav-talente.title: Talents
nav-talente.body: The complete talent list with filters for position, status, and alert — this is also where you create new talents.

talents-filters.title: Filter by selection & development programs
talents-filters.body: In addition to position, contract status, and alert, you can filter the list by DFB talent center, regional select team, national team, NLZ status, and EU passport.

talent-detail.title: On the talent detail page
talent-detail.body: Update club and team, link a Transfermarkt/FuPa profile, upload video highlights, document injuries, note talented siblings, view the coarse comparison with other talents of the same position and birth year — and more. To keep things clear with so much detail, the sections below the overview are collapsible: tap to expand or collapse.

nav-candidates.title: Candidates
nav-candidates.body: Players can apply directly to your club via a public form. Here you review incoming applications, request a video or sporting CV upfront if needed, and add them as a regular talent by accepting them — or decline them. For minors, an application only appears after the parent or guardian has given consent.

nav-alerts.title: Alerts & Follow-ups
nav-alerts.body: All open action items in one place — automatic alerts and follow-ups you've set yourself.

nav-watchlists.title: Watchlists
nav-watchlists.body: An overview of all your watchlists with talent counts.

nav-import.title: Import
nav-import.body: Import existing scouting lists via CSV or XLSX, including column mapping.

nav-abo.title: Subscription
nav-abo.body: Your current plan and trial period — after the free trial ends, you'll choose a subscription here.

nav-verwaltung.title: Administration
nav-verwaltung.body: Edit the club name, assign the club to a regional football association, manage team members (role, youth protection access, deactivate) and invite new scouts by email.

finish.title: Ready to get started
finish.body: That's it! You can restart the tour anytime via "Getting-Started Tour" in the bottom left of the sidebar.
